criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.notes: Names the claim ($150M/year, 1 GW, vs Texas), signals correction is coming, stakes the deadline (May 29). Asserter identified as 'Alaska's governor' in line 1, named in para 2 — minor gap from 10.

criteria.name: Claim load-bearing + AK stakes
criteria.notes: Air Force RLP at JBER/Eielson/Clear, live May 29 2026 deadline. Consequence specific: mispriced bids and a bad procurement template for future cycles.

criteria.name: Steelman fairness
criteria.notes: Full paragraph before rebuttal. Cites Iceland/Norway PUEs, free-air cooling, directional logic 'legitimate', 'right to lead with this.' Generous and specific, zero snark.

criteria.name: Counter-evidence quality
criteria.notes: Two UAF ACEP primary sources plus Chugach primary quote. Stan Jones ADN rate comparison is credible named secondary — not primary. All in dossier.

criteria.name: Factual density
criteria.notes: Named specifics in nearly every sentence: governor, Data Center World Oct 2025, two outlets, UAF ACEP Feb 2024, 5% fraction, Mar 2025 analysis, Stan Jones, ADN Apr 12, rate figures, Chugach, ADN May 5, JBER/Eielson/Clear, May 29 deadline.

criteria.name: Source quality
criteria.notes: Two independent claim-assertion outlets. Two UAF ACEP primary counter-sources, one Chugach primary quote, one named-journalist ADN opinion. All in dossier. One non-primary prevents 10.

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.notes: Analytical and structural throughout, no influencer cadence, no dunking. 'Five percent.' standalone is mildly emphatic but stays analytical.

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria.notes: 2-4 sentence paragraphs, ~448 words, well under 3000-char cap. Scans cleanly on desktop and mobile.

criteria.name: Engagement question
criteria.notes: Real, debatable, tied to electricity rate as the corrected cost driver. No follow-us, no rhetorical softener.

criteria.name: Business actionability
criteria.notes: An exec or program manager can name a concrete action: stress-test the power-rate assumption before submitting a May 29 Air Force RLP bid rather than anchoring to the $150M cooling headline.

one_sentence_fix: Replace or supplement the Stan Jones ADN opinion rate figures with a primary dataset (EIA Form 861 or Chugach rate schedule) to push the electricity-rate rebuttal onto a primary source.
